posts.title: A note on $L^2 \leftrightarrow L^1$ duality in shallow homogeneous nets
posts.description: If you’ve been around the deep learning theory block long enough to get to know the locals, you’ve probably heard something like this at some point: In a shallow homogeneous neural net, minimizing the $L^2$-norm of the parameters is equivalent to minimizing the $L^1$-norm of a measure over unit-norm neurons.
